answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Every claim climbs the thread of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the zephyr re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The raven of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
